verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only inbound migration: importing from ~/.ssh and CSV files. The only export it mentions is pushing public keys to authorized_keys, a key-deployment feature rather than a data export. Nothing shows a way to export hosts, groups, snippets, credentials, port-forwarding rules or logs in open formats so a user can leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
